fieldValues.title: D2 Composed semantic document
fieldValues.summary: Blueprints, type inheritance, shared Fields and package definitions compose validated multi-record documents without making the editor own the ontology.
fieldValues.body:
## Group Need

We need documents with repeatable structure and reusable concepts, rather than one-off forms for every guide or policy.

## Semantic Adds

- Blueprint structure
- reusable Field and Type definitions
- package-level document vocabulary

## Blueprint Adds

- guide, policy or specification structure
- reusable section forms

## Does Not Introduce

- automatic publication
- cross-installation package discovery
- application-specific semantics in the core

## Activation Trigger

A group repeats document patterns and wants structure to be reusable, reviewable and independently understandable.

## Research

- problem-index/09-distribution/package-system.md: A reusable document library distributes its definitions, Views, DocumentViews, Protocols and Themes as one explicit package closure.
